name: MCW World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The fed's top singles belt, shown on its champions page as the World title: Rayne Young held it from All Hallows Annihilation on 19 November 2007, Annie Alvarez took it at Purgatory on 25 February 2008, and Dazz's roleplays carry it from Rayne Young to Dazz, Angelica Jones and back to Dazz between July and December 2009.
notes: The champions page's plate is a World Championship image; Dazz's roleplays call the belt the World Heavyweight title.

name: MCW TV Championship
epitaph: A secondary singles belt shown on its champions page by a TV Champ plate: Rayne Young is champion on the capture of 7 January 2008, over Eric Moreland, and the title stands vacated from Mayhem on 28 January 2008.

name: MCW Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Kaplan James and Shitface McKee held it from 3 November 2007 until BROS beat them and three other men at Purgatory on 25 February 2008; Dazz's roleplays show Southern Blood holding it in 2009 and Vitriol and Ambrosia taking it two weeks before Nightmare Before Christmas.

name: MCW Brutality Championship
epitaph: Priest held it from All Hallows Annihilation on 19 November 2007, when he beat Whitecloud for it, until Annie Alvarez took it from him and Jonas Griffin at Mayhem on 28 January 2008; a ladder match on 7 April 2008 named a number one contender for her.

name: MCW Women's Championship
epitaph: Annie Alvarez is billed its champion on the Mayhem card of 7 April 2008, defending against Angelica Jones; the fed's news of 26 February 2008 says its Women's title information was being revamped.

name: MCW Motor City Championship
epitaph: A belt named for the city: Dazz's roleplays make Angelica Jones its champion in September 2009, with a Motor City contender match on 7 September 2009; it was stripped from her on 2 November 2009 in a title-versus-title match and was contested again at Nightmare Before Christmas.

name: MCW Global Championship
epitaph: The belt of the Livewire brand, introduced with its debut on 21 January 2010: Dazz is its first champion by his own account and keeps it past Jay Williams that night.

name: MCW Millenium Championship
epitaph: A Livewire belt, spelled Millenium in the roleplays: Segador is its first and current champion by Dazz's account of 4 February 2010, and keeps it against Aerik Walker on the first Livewire.
